# PEANUTS: hold the frame governor at 60 (hle_fpslock.c EXTRA_VSYNCS_U8 row for Echoes of Wisdom)
# The game's frame governor (hle_fpslock.c, the "Grezzo frame governor enable" row for main 9f221e1a) drops to 30 after one frame over 1/60 s and, measuring
# wall time at interval 2, never comes back. The target turns it off (60) or holds it at 30; 0 would leave the game's own logic.
# The game selects near=0 with nvnDeviceSetDepthMode; offline pipeline bases must use main0_z too.
